note: Designated topics for the post-agents-wiki-sync pipeline step. Each entry pins an AGENTS-surface pointer to a docs/wiki/concepts page and a machine-maintained 'Current State / Progress' page in this folder, so agents read the current state of a topic instead of re-discovering it ('gegen im Kreis drehen'). A task is matched to a topic by a shared tag or by a changed-file path prefix. Edit this file to add or retune topics; the sibling <slug>.md pages and README.md index are regenerated by the step.
